what: New Makefile-only /bug harness is planned without required sibling docs/lint registration
scenario_or_breakage: The plan adds scripts/test-bug-structure.sh and wires it into make lint, but repo rules require every scripts/*.sh harness to have a sibling .md, and existing Makefile-only harnesses are registered in agent-lint excludes. As planned, make lint or the script-doc invariant can fail after the new harness lands
suggested_fix: Add ### NEW: scripts/test-bug-structure.md and ### UPDATED: agent-lint.toml entries for the new harness and sibling, following the scripts/test-alias-structure.sh pattern
